title: Ing Tronu a miglakbe keng metung a penandit
intro: Metung a taung ating maragul a upaya ing mig-ari keng metung a mabandi a kayarian a binindisyunan na ning pibandian a alang sukad. Inyang mika e asahan a hamon, ing pekapun a ini arapan na ing kapagsubukan e king espada nune king kabiasnan at kasalpantayanan. Ing milyari magdala ya ibat keng taluktuk ning upaya ning yatu papunta keng malalam a pamagbayu ning pusu.
clues: Mig-ari ku king metung a kayarian a mipanuanan king pibandian at kasaganaan a e na aisip
metung kung mayupayang ari na tinanggap metung a matapang a sulat a maniawad pamagpasakop
Ding kanakung marangal pepayu da kanaku nung lumaban ku o makipagkasundu keting marayung ari
miglakbe kung ating mangasanting a regalu para akit ke ining marayung ari
Midala ya ing tronu kung ari king marayung bansa king kimut ning mata, bayu ku mibalik
Inyang linub ku keng palasyu na ing sapin na makinis ya kalupa ning salamin, pepabalu ku ing kanakung pamagpasakop kang Allah

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
